prism_dispositions.title: Native window lookup and key events are dispatched from a background goroutine
prism_dispositions.disposition: Refuted by source inspection and independent internal review.
facts: system/driver/base/app_multi.go WindowByName locks App.Mu while reading the list. Smoke fixture names are stable after native readiness.
system/driver/base/window_multi.go Events returns the stable address of the window Event field.
events/source.go Source.KeyChord constructs a fresh key event, calls its Init, and enqueues through Deque.Send. It does not mutate Source.Last or dispatch widget handlers.
events/deque.go Deque.Send holds Deque.Mu. KeyChord events are unique FIFO items, so synthetic chords retain their ordering.
Application.Do serializes application ownership; it does not marshal native-main execution. No change to this safe producer path is needed.

prism_dispositions.title: StopMain posts an empty event that may reach an already-terminated GLFW or a nil This
facts: The first stop could signal termination before its SendEmptyEvent call, allowing GLFW to terminate before that wake. A nil This also panicked.
StopMain now closes its stable signal and releases waiters without posting any native wake. Desktop MainLoop already uses WaitEventsTimeout(0.1); base queue loop directly selects the signal.
TestVellumMainQueueStopNeedsNoNativeWake checks nil This and a fake native backend whose SendEmptyEvent panics. Repeated stop, main-loop exit and post-stop callback refusal pass.
Fresh prepare, integrated checks, 20 queue race repetitions and four native smokes pass on the corrected bytes.

discarded_nested_creation_assessment: Internal review audited installed DPI and accessibility hooks, newGlfwWindow, updateGeometry and direct geometry helpers; no reachable nested main-queue dispatch exists for this Vellum driver. Replacement hooks retain the non-reentrancy contract.
